original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Read the gzip-container reproducibility examples and distinguish frozen source bytes from regenerated payloads.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Independently audit whether the omitted _gauge_ann field remains proof-relevant in the paired-cube companion frame export and whether the complete producer check detects a field-only mutation.
scope_change_reason: Open PR #3545 already demonstrates equality of canonical word payloads after changing _gauge_ann. This session narrows to the independent cross-output implication instead of repeating its payload-level fixture.
bottleneck_link: Canonical payload equality is only meaningful for proof data if an omitted field is either intentionally irrelevant or retained and checked in the companion artifact bundle.
stop_rule: Stop after one pair of exact annihilator spaces leaves the decompressed word equal, changes the producer's actual companion frame export, and the source-bound --check path is confirmed to compare that frame file.
evidence: PASS_CANONICAL_GAUGE_FRAME_CROSSCHECK: a mutation of _gauge_ann leaves the gzip word payload unchanged but changes the actual export() gauge frame reference and exact frames record. The pinned generator adds export products to its names map and byte-compares every output, so the complete --check rejects this mutation. A public-field mutation changes the word payload.
